review_description: I installed a solar battery  and it was a good experience, good battery and top installer.  Farah is a very polite, hard working, knowledgeable and wonderful man, done a very good job, I’m very glad.

Sales was very good and took personal care to answer all our questions. They did make an error on the vicgov rebate site that caused application to be redone- but the issue was sorted. Installation was very good, on time, polite, tidy and consulted with me before they started. Have said that they will organise grid connection and inspection but that is yet to happen- still a bit early. No problems so far so I can't comment on after service.

i get quote they supply something different  after install, found the roof  had heavy leakage, I connect back with them, they gave me appointment, didn't show up I call them again, they refuse to answer so i had to call another company. I try now to go to v cat.
These guys took my deposit then lied about their delisting as an approved fitter and disappeared with my money even after I demanded my money back .

Under any circumstances do not use or have anything to do with RVB, even if they are $500 cheaper. You will pay that and more in the end financially and emotionally. Just trying to get the job finished and connected to the grid. Mine is a long story, they will stop answering calls or messages and if they do answer, they make promises which they don't keep. My installation was was started in February 2023, finally finished in March but they did not send the Application to connect to the grid to my supplier till June after I contacted them. It was rejected 4 times because it was not correct. For 2 months, I have been trying to get them to arrange a truck appointment without luck. I have hired an independent Electrician and he arrange it in 1 day.The solar was paid for in full, in March, but I have had no solar credits for the last 8 months due to their incomitance.So BAD on so many levels.

This experience was terrible. Asked for money back several times to be fobbed off. Installation was in December after payment in full and 100 per cent guarantee of installation in September. 5 months to get certified. Avoid this company.
Best price of all great installation very happy with service

I used RVB solar and my system failed electrical compliance for dodgy wiring, if left like that it had potential to cause an electrical fire and possibly burn my shed down.I have tried for 4 weeks to resolve this issue and as I said they will not answer the phone.In your interest and the safety of your property I highly recommend that you do not use them, I think they are a back yard operation .
The installation went seamlessly. One day delay because of rain but the following day the workers arrived promptly & were efficient & friendly. Very happy to recommend this company,
